privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: What this installation of Inventari keeps about the people who use it, who runs it, and how to ask for a copy of your data or its deletion.

demo.heading: This is a public demo
demo.wiped: Nothing here is meant to last. Every night the whole demo is wiped — every organization, account and file created in it — and rebuilt from sample data. Do not enter real data.
demo.inbox: The demo sends no real email: every message it would send, with any address typed into it, lands in one inbox that every visitor can read.

operator.heading: Who runs this installation
operator.name: It is run by {{name}}.
operator.noName: Its operator has not published their name.
operator.noContact: No contact has been published — ask whoever gave you access to it.
operator.setupHint: Running this installation yourself? Set OPERATOR_NAME and OPERATOR_CONTACT in the server's configuration and they appear here.

stored.heading: What is stored about you
stored.account: Your account: your email address, your name, your chosen language, and your password as a one-way hash — never the password itself.
stored.activity: A record of the changes you make — to products, stock and documents — kept with your account, so your organization can see who did what.
stored.organization: What you enter for your organization — products, documents, files — belongs to the organization and stays with it.
stored.logs: The server's technical logs record the network address each request comes from, and the email address of a failed sign-in and of each message the server sends, for security and troubleshooting.
stored.outside: There is no analytics and no tracking. Data leaves this installation only for services your organization connects itself, such as an AI provider or a mail server.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.session: One cookie keeps you signed in. The application cannot work without it, and it is removed when you sign out.
cookies.demo: On the demo, a second cookie brings this browser back to its own demo organization, for up to two days.
cookies.local: Your browser also remembers your language and display choices on this device. Nothing is used for advertising or tracking.

requests.heading: A copy of your data, or its deletion
requests.how: Ask the operator of this installation (see above) for a copy of the data held about you, or to have it deleted. Requests are answered within 30 days.
requests.erasure: Deletion replaces the name, email address and password on your account and closes it; the changes made from it stay in the organization's history, tied to the closed account. Your email address can remain in records written before the deletion — the organization's history of its members and its invitations — and in the server's technical logs. Deletion does not rewrite those, so mention them in your request if you want them removed as well.
requests.demo: On the demo, the nightly wipe deletes every account, organization, file and message created in it. The server's technical logs are not part of that wipe; they are kept for seven days and then deleted.
